interpretation: The previous MM-PBSA run used docking_results_full/4GIZ/<LIG>.pdb (the undocked input, not a Vina pose) as the MD starting structure. A 72 A centroid shift shows the uploaded structure is not even in the receptor frame of the docked pose. Caveat: the PDBQT pose carries polar hydrogens only (16 atoms) while the uploaded PDB has 26, so the RMSD below is computed on the first min(N) atoms in file order, not on a verified atom mapping; the centroid shift, not the RMSD, is the decisive evidence.

fix LEaP atom order: receptor -> Zn ions -> ligand, and record it in the run log
acceptance gate: both Zn sites stay 4-coordinated and the initial contact persists in a short run; otherwise stop and fix the model, do not extend sampling
